description: Single previously exposed YCB marker, native textured mesh, scripted source-cap active path and fixed real RGB witnesses. Development diagnostics only; not training or unseen evaluation.
support_motion: Within 240 steps: lower 40 mm, move +X150 mm at fixed height until entirely beyond catch, then lower further60 mm. Geometry preflight must prove fixture/catch clearance. No object state writes after initialization.
distance_tolerance_basis: Existing native contact offset 1 mm plus object offset 1 mm and 0.1 mm numerical allowance; measured distances are retained. This does not certify hardware or exact cooked/visible surface equality.
success_scope: Actual 30 mm minimum held lift, 50 mm minimum held XY transport and 0.1 rad palm rotation; continuous native-face load support, <=5 mm / 5 degree palm-relative slip, natural release. Frozen native_active_verdict.py applies.
arm_drive_rationale: Use the verified native force-drive semantics in the ephemeral scene; source USD remains acceleration and is not saved. Six source effort caps 60/60/30/10/10/10 Nm, gains1000/100 and0.5rad/s match marker001 and contact007. This is simulation source consistency, not hardware calibration.
solver_order_rationale: Omni Physics 107.3 articulation stability guide identifies persistent contact penetration with competing stiff/mimic constraints as a use for solving dynamic articulation contacts later. Isolated scene-only change; 32 position/8 velocity iterations, timestep, all drives and geometry unchanged. Outcome remains a diagnostic.
active_motion_planning: Reuse the frozen source-arm wrist-lift and independent yaw-transport path. Actual recorded marker poses, original-source-face contacts and natural release alone decide the frozen criterion. Marker fixture and catch dimensions are derived from its actual source vertices; old block catch margins do not apply.
arm_effort_rationale: Retain all six hash-bound source URDF effort limits already verified in007 and marker001. This object precision comparison does not change any joint gain, force cap or velocity cap.
material_semantics: Original object package material 0.7/0.5 preserved, robot/fixture uniform 0.5/0.5; actual bindings and runtime parameters recorded. This is not the single-variable 006/007 comparison.
object_pose_rule: Source X to palm Y, source Y to minus palm X, source Z to palm Z; rigid-root origin at palm[0,0,.14], no scaling. Original AABB midpoint differs from root by sub-micrometre source asymmetry; do not relabel root as an exactly centred bound.
collision_precision_rationale: 001 source/scene mesh identical but default16 hulls have sampled exterior vertices up to4.499mm from source surface and persistent bad contact normals. Compare the pre-existing uniform native collision precision settings as an ephemeral Object-only derivation; no mesh/scale/material/mass/force/path/criteria/camera changes. Automatically computed object COM/inertia may change as dependent results of recooking and must be reported, not forced back or called unchanged.
